title: Bulgarian admissions to correctional facilities Jan 2018 - Nov 2024

description.en: Semantically annotated data conforming to the RRAO ontology (http://w3id.org/rrao#), related to admissions to correctional facilities (n=76,520) of imprisoned persons (m=33,171) from Jan 2018 up to Nov. 2024 (a period of six years and ten months). The data was extracted from the Execution of Sentences Information System (ESIS), a centralised system managed by the General Directorate Execution of Sentences, which operates across all prison facilities and probation services in Bulgaria. Sensitive information kept in the dataset has been anonymized.
